tested:
ArubaOS-CX simulator - VERIFIED 2026-06-25: will NOT boot on the generic 512 MB default
(it just sits at a black serial console forever); needs ~1.5 GB+. Keys cover the registered
name (arubacx) and the canonical alias (aos-cx). x86_64, virtio.

reasons.qemu_version_default: NPX-1657 rule #59: pc-1.0 only in QEMU <6.2 (EVE default 2.x)
reasons.min_ram_mb: rule #59 (Wave 17): default = EVE-NG arubacx RAM 4096; the old 2048 had no written reason
reasons.config_dialect:
W177-G1 (2026-08-30): the vendor string "aruba" has NO CLI dialect and must not
get one - Aruba's other products in this file (aruba-vmc, arubaamp, arubafc,
arubanet, clearpass) are all `"console": "vnc"` appliances with entirely
different CLIs. ArubaOS-CX's verbs were proven on a real netplex boot of this
image (ArubaOS-CX 10.07.0004) and match EVE-NG's own config_arubacx.py verb for
verb. Named per-IMAGE, which is the NPX-617 lesson: one vendor, several
products, only one of them speaks this CLI. Set on BOTH keys - "arubacx" and its
canonical alias "aoscx" are the same image and must not disagree.

settings.description: ArubaOS-CX virtual switch - requires 2 vCPUs per the vendor template (NPX-308 fix); needs ≥1.5 GB RAM to boot.
